mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate trend is downward.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market slack that prompts central bank rate cuts, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) below 1450 and 750000 respectively indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1450 and RSAFS < 750000, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 105 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), manufacturing output growth slows, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO > 105 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.5% (GDPC1 > 24150) signals strong economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 335.0, it indicates accelerating inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 335.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS < 158000) and housing starts (HOUST < 1450) indicates labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS < 158000 and HOUST < 1450, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 330.0), central bank rate hikes cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 330.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.
